title: Bug: The deprecated vrf definition command is no longer accepted in cEOS 4.35
author: yaopingzhu-arista
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Critical

### Description of the bug

The test_bgp_stress_link_flap.py failed due to unreachable T2 neighbors. The reason is the old VRF configuration syntax, vrf definition, is no longer accepted by cEOS 4.35, which caused the missing VRF configuration on the management interface and the subsequent shutdown/no_shutdown actions
failed due to unreachable host error.


### Steps to Reproduce

Run test_bgp_stress_link_flap.py on t1-64-lag topo. 

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Test should pass. All neighbor VMs should be reachable.

### Relevant log output

```shell
Not all BGP sessions are established on DUT
```

### Output of `show version`

```shell

```

### Attach files (if any)

_No response_

comments.author: wrideout-arista
comments.body: the old vrf syntax on EOS was deprecated in 2018 in favor of the "vrf instance" syntax.  Both commands were runnable up until 4.35.0, where the old "vrf definition" syntax was permanently removed.
